text:
If you’re trying to fit in a walk or a waterfront errand, today gets more comfortable, even if the clouds never fully give up. Burlington is sitting at 57 now, with a high near 70, and the air should gradually dry out with a few brighter breaks possible. The models are split on how warm we get, from the mid 60s to around 70, so I’d bet on the cooler side if the cloud deck hangs tough. South winds stay manageable on land, but they’ll build over the lake to 10 to 15 knots, with waves up to a foot or so.

Thursday is the warmer, breezier day, partly sunny with a high around 74. South winds could gust near 26, and the lake may turn choppy with winds reaching 15 to 25 knots. A shower could arrive Thursday afternoon, though the steadier chance is after midnight. Enjoy the lake today, and plan to be off the broad water before Thursday’s wind ramps up.

week.blurb: Clouds hold the sky near 70, with a mild south breeze and no rain to plan around.
A partly sunny, breezy day near 74, with showers holding off until after midnight.
Rain showers likely make Friday a damp one near 70, with another shower possible before 11pm.
Sunshine returns Saturday, but a north breeze keeps it cool near 62, with a clear, chilly night.
Mostly sunny and near 65 Sunday, with a few showers possible after 8pm.
A cool, breezy Monday near 58 brings a few showers, with clearing and colder air overnight.
Mostly sunny but brisk Tuesday, near 53, with a clear night dropping to around 36.
